subject: Kimi released for manual handover; actual DeepSeek stop status
body:
Kimi MANUAL HANDOVER: released to Ziggy. No Kimi browser/native control is active; root and helpers applied no project instructions, uploaded no files and submitted no Kimi message. No UI call is being made. All live helpers are file-only or complete. Preserve Qwen setup; no competing operator.

DeepSeek: direct human approval to use Harness was received. The last actual sequence was list_apps (Harness detected), get_window/get_window_state (weak text only), screenshot request (FrameArrived timeout), then refresh/activate/capture interrupted by the user's physical Escape. Native tool explicitly required stopping Computer Use. There is NO verified pending platform-approval prompt or action ID/location to direct Ziggy to. The stale 'awaiting approval' wording is not the current blocker. No onboarding was applied. This handover does not resume native work or bypass a platform prompt.

Kimi instructions: onboarding_current_20261011/kimi/PROJECT_INSTRUCTIONS.txt; shared CURRENT_TASK_SUPPLEMENT.txt in its parent. Root read both. Existing release packs/kimi has nine verified files matching index. Ziggy can paste instructions into the supported field and upload those nine documents plus the supplement himself. Readback only; setup does not launch Phase 0. Exact materials will be returned in the current response. No direct PA app send is retried after the recorded AbsolutePathBuf routing error.

Reviewed current ownership, Prime status and Phase 0 boundaries

source.note: Urgent manual Kimi handover explicitly requested by Ziggy; no UI resumption requested.
